contributions.statement: When validating an LLM judge against a small expert-labelled audit set, choose the subset whose judge-versus-other-models agreement best matches the full population instead of sampling at random; expect modest gains concentrated at very small budgets.
contributions.evidence: §4.1.1 Fig. 2: 18.7% average reduction in reliability-estimation error; but §4.2 Table 1 per-trial micro win-rate is 0.538 (macro 0.838) and App. H shows contexts worse than random; text-quality datasets, not code review.

reason: A clever sampling trick whose per-trial advantage over random is close to a coin flip; it is worth trying when expert labels for content review are scarce, but it is not a gate.
